description: On the table in front of you, there’s a white cup-shaped piece near the center-left and a white lamp-like base with a round top on the right. The right hand reaches forward to grasp the cup-shaped piece, lifts it up and carries it rightward toward the lamp base, then lowers and aligns it onto the top of the base as if assembling the parts, while the left hand stays resting on the table without touching any object.
